title: MCGI: Manifold-Consistent Graph Indexing for Billion-Scale Disk-Resident Vector Search
abstract: arXiv:2601.01930v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search often suffers from performance degradation in high-dimensional spaces due to the Euclidean-Geodesic mismatch, where greedy routing diverges from the underlying data manifold. To address this challenge, this paper presents Manifold-Consistent Graph Indexing (MCGI), a geometry-aware and disk-resident indexing method that leverages Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (LID) to allocate the search effort of a graph index according to the intrinsic geometry of data. Specifically, MCGI estimates the LID around each query from the distances that its own search has already computed and resizes the candidate list of the query once, so that queries in high-LID regions receive longer lists while queries in low-LID regions terminate earlier; the estimate itself costs no additional disk reads. translated_title: MCGI：面向十亿级规模磁盘驻留向量搜索的流形一致图索引
translated_abstract: 基于图的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索在高维空间中常因“欧几里得-测地线失配”（即贪婪路由偏离底层数据流形）而出现性能下降。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了流形一致图索引（MCGI），这是一种几何感知、可驻留磁盘的索引方法，利用局部内在维度（LID）根据数据的内在几何结构来分配图索引的搜索开销。具体而言，MCGI 从查询自身搜索已计算出的距离来估计该查询周围的 LID，并仅对候选列表进行一次尺寸调整：位于高 LID 区域的查询获得更长的候选列表，而低 LID 区域的查询则更早终止；该估计本身不产生任何额外的磁盘读取。理论分析表明，任何固定搜索列表的成功概率随……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MCGI——一种利用局部内在维度（LID）感知数据几何的磁盘驻留图索引方法，能够自适应分配搜索开销，以缓解高维ANN搜索中的欧几里得-测地线失配问题。
en_tdlr: MCGI is a geometry-aware, disk-resident graph indexing method that leverages Local Intrinsic Dimensionality to adaptively allocate search effort, mitigating the Euclidean-Geodesic mismatch for billion-scale vector search on disk.
